response.justification: Bogdan is a broad, seasoned engineer with genuine developer-tooling credentials — he built a test runner and assertion library for D, contributed C/C++ components to NI LabWindows/CVI (an IDE product), and works on MCP code generators and agentic dev tooling today. However, the role's core requirements are Java/Kotlin depth, JVM internals, and hands-on Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience, and the resume shows almost none of this: Java appears only as a passing mention in a 2016–2018 robotics/device-orchestration context, Kotlin and Spring are entirely absent, and the last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and D. The tooling instinct and complex-systems track record are real assets, but the ecosystem gap is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise-framework subsystems from day one.
strengths: Real IDE/developer-tooling experience (LabWindows/CVI, custom test runner, assertion library)
Proven work on complex, high-throughput systems (low-latency D microservices at Sociomantic)
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, plus teaching and conference speaking
concerns: No demonstrable Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience
Kotlin absent and Java only peripheral, ~8 years ago; no evidence of JVM depth
Recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node and D rather than enterprise JVM ecosystems
